function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1, which the documentation confirms means 'customer did not supply an age' — a missing-data sentinel.", "implication": "We must decide how to handle these -1 values when computing mean age. If we include them, the mean age will be pulled down (since -1 is less than all real ages). But they are not actual ages. Including them would bias the result. Therefore, we must exclude them from the mean calculation. This changes the analysis: we compute the mean age only for customers with valid age data (i.e., age != -1) among those who converted."}
function.name: note_finding
